name: Talkpage — AI Voice Sales Agent
author: ieasysell

sections.description:
Talkpage helps WordPress and WooCommerce sites guide visitors with AI-powered voice and chat conversations, shoppable media, and digital-human style product presentations.

Key Features

  • AI sales conversations in 30+ languages.
  • Voice and avatar-style shopper assistance.
  • Product guidance for WordPress and WooCommerce stores.
  • Shoppable media experiences and live selling workflows.
  • Secure WordPress connection flow with authenticated product sync.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the Talkpage plugin.
  2. Open the Talkpage page in WordPress admin and connect your Talkpage account.
  3. Complete the secure connection flow in the Talkpage web app.
  4. Configure your digital human or sales agent inside Talkpage.
  5. Publish the Talkpage experience on your WordPress site.

Core Features

🎙️ AI Voice Shopping Assistant
Real-time 1-on-1 voice interaction in 30+ languages, available 24/7. Your AI assistant answers product questions, makes recommendations, and guides customers to checkout — just like a human sales rep, but always available.

🎬 Shoppable Video
Showcase your products with close-up video experiences. Customers can watch and buy without ever leaving the video — reducing drop-off and increasing conversion rates.

📡 Live Shopping
Host live product demos directly on your WordPress site. Your AI presenter introduces products in real time with instant one-click purchase capability. Engage viewers and convert them while they watch.

📖 AI Product Catalog & Video Handbook
Attach close-up demo videos and digital product handbooks to any WooCommerce product listing. Let your products speak for themselves — literally.

🧬 Custom AI Persona
Choose from pre-built public AI models or fully customize your assistant’s face, voice, and personality to match your brand identity. Your AI, your brand.

📊 Conversation Analytics & AI Intent Analysis
Every conversation is stored and analyzed. Talkpage’s AI intent scoring identifies high-value leads automatically — so your team follows up at exactly the right moment.

🔌 Easy WordPress Integration
Install the plugin, paste your API key, and you’re live. Works seamlessly with WooCommerce. Also supports any website via a single line of JavaScript.

Perfect For

  • DTC (direct-to-consumer) brands selling to global markets
  • Fashion, beauty, electronics, home goods — any visual product category
  • WooCommerce store owners who want to cut support costs while increasing conversion
  • Stores expanding from English-speaking markets into multilingual audiences
  • Merchants who want to replace static product pages with interactive video experiences

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the Talkpage plugin
  2. Connect your Talkpage account (free to start at Talkpage.com)
  3. Configure your AI assistant — choose persona, languages, and linked products
  4. Upload shoppable product videos and set up your first live shopping event
  5. Embed on any page or let it auto-appear site-wide — your AI sales rep is live

Supported Languages (30+)

English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Hindi, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Greek, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, Hebrew, and more.

Integrations

  • WooCommerce — native product sync, cart integration, and order tracking
  • WordPress — works with any theme or page builder (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg)
  • Any website — paste one line of JavaScript to embed on non-WordPress pages
  • Shopify — also available on the Shopify App Store

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party external services to provide Digital Human embedding functionality.

  • Service Name: Talkpage Digital Human Service
  • Service Provider: Talkpage (talkpage.ai)
  • Purpose: This service is used to load and render interactive digital human video components on the frontend of WordPress websites to enhance user engagement and sales conversion.
  • Data Transmission Description:
    • Content Sent: When pages containing digital human components are loaded, the plugin sends requests to app.ieasysell.com to load necessary JavaScript resources (digital-human-embed.js). Depending on the implementation of this service, user IP addresses, User-Agent strings, and the current page URL may be sent to properly render content and analyze usage. If user input occurs during digital human interactions, related data may also be transmitted to that server for processing.
    • Timing: The frontend Talkpage script appears to be loaded globally after the plugin is connected and their browsers execute the embedded script.
    • Conditions: The connection will be established as long as the administrator has enabled the digital human feature in the plugin settings and placed it on a page.
      *Privacy Policy: https://talkpage.ai/privacy-policy
      *terms service: https://talkpage.ai/terms-of-service
      *security: https://talkpage.ai/security

Note: Using this feature indicates your agreement with the above third-party terms of service and privacy policy. It’s recommended to inform your website visitors before enabling this feature.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Talkpage”
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate
  5. Go to wp-admin menu “Talkpage” and follow the connection flow
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is only required if you use the /products REST endpoint.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Secured the Talkpage REST endpoints with per-installation request authentication.
  • Replaced the legacy MD5-based connection flow with a per-installation signed handshake.
  • Added proper uninstall cleanup for all stored plugin options.
  • Added real pagination to the authenticated products endpoint.
  • Reduced exposed product fields to the data returned by the authenticated sync endpoint.
  • Rebranded customer-facing admin screens to Talkpage.
  • Internationalized WordPress-admin strings and added a translation template.
  • Updated marketplace copy, tags, and external-services disclosure.

1.0.1

  • Showcase your products with close-up video experiences
  • Dynamically display the corresponding location on the website while answering
  • Starts conversations automatically when shoppers hesitate or abandon cart
  • Recommends products, adds to cart, and applies discount codes in chat
  • automatically switch corresponding video explanation when visit specific product

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
